summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/) and uses the downloaded Bun binary to execute a bundled 727KB single-line file, math_init.js, which is heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (shuffled string-array rotation, hex-named identifiers, encoded numeric constant tables). The loader itself (setup.mjs) is also obfuscator.io-renamed (hex-suffixed local identifiers, per-call string-property lookup objects), which is inconsistent with a babel preset from a corporate shared-configs monorepo. A babel-preset package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a large obfuscated blob for execution under it. The alternate-runtime pattern here is used to run bundled attacker-controlled code under a runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection; the executed payload's behavior is opaque due to obfuscation, but installing the package causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
